ideas.title: Minnesota's healthcare industry under scrutiny for fraud
ideas.description: Investigating the pattern of fraudulent activity in Minnesota's healthcare industry
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the connections between entities and individuals involved in the fraud cases
questions: What are the common factors among the entities and individuals involved in the fraud cases?
